jp: あなたは漁船の網を使った。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは漁船の網を使った。"
en: You used the net of fishing ship.
en_grezzo: "You used the net of fishing ship."
it: Hai usato la rete del peschereccio.

jp: あっという間に魚が匹獲れたが、残りには逃げられてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "あっという間に魚が" + kazu + "匹獲れたが、残りには逃げられてしまった。"
en: You caught  fishs in no time, but the rest of them got away.
en_grezzo: "You caught " + kazu + " fishs in no time, but the rest of them got away."
contesto: txt lang("あっという間に魚が" + kazu + "匹獲れたが、残りには逃げられてしまった。", "You caught " + kazu + " fishs in no time, but the rest of them got away.")
it: "Hai preso " + kazu + " pesci in un attimo, ma gli altri sono scappati."

jp: 謎の船影
前方に船影を発見した。ここからでは何の船かよく分からない。
jp_grezzo: "前方に船影を発見した。ここからでは何の船かよく分からない。"
en: You spot a ship's shadow ahead. You don't quite know what ship it is from here.
en_grezzo: "You spot a ship's shadow ahead. You don't quite know what ship it is from here."
it: Davanti a te si profila l'ombra di una nave. Da qui non capisci di che nave si tratti.

jp: 近づいてみる
とりあえず先制攻撃
攻撃に驚き、船は慌てて逃げていった。
jp_grezzo: "攻撃に驚き、船は慌てて逃げていった。"
en: Surprised by the attack, the ship fled in a panic.
en_grezzo: "Surprised by the attack, the ship fled in a panic."
it: Colta di sorpresa dall'attacco, la nave è fuggita in tutta fretta.

jp: 砲撃が命中！相手の船耐久が減少した。
jp_grezzo: "砲撃が命中！相手の船耐久が減少した。"
en: Artillery hit! Opponent's ship durability has decreased.
en_grezzo: "Artillery hit! Opponent's ship durability has decreased."
it: Colpo di cannone a segno! La resistenza dello scafo nemico è calata.

jp: 魚雷が命中！相手の船耐久が減少した。
jp_grezzo: "魚雷が命中！相手の船耐久が減少した。"
en: Torpedoes hit! Opponent's ship durability has decreased.
en_grezzo: "Torpedoes hit! Opponent's ship durability has decreased."
it: Siluro a segno! La resistenza dello scafo nemico è calata.

jp: 流される者
波間にもがいている漂流者を発見した。「高波にさらわれてこんなところまで流されてしまったよ！」
jp_grezzo: "波間にもがいている漂流者を発見した。「高波にさらわれてこんなところまで流されてしまったよ！」"
en: You found a drifter drowning in the waves.
en_grezzo: "You found a drifter drowning in the waves."
it: Hai trovato un naufrago che annaspa fra le onde.

jp: 見捨てる
乗せてあげる
浮き輪を１つ投げて去る
「そんなぁ…」
「ごぼぼぼぼ…」
「乗せてよー！」
en: Let me on! Let me onnnn!!!
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Let me on! Let me onnnn!!!")

jp: 無事に陸まで連れて行ってあげよう。
jp_grezzo: "無事に陸まで連れて行ってあげよう。"
en: You should get the drifter to shore safely.
en_grezzo: "You should get the drifter to shore safely."
it: Bisogna portarlo a riva sano e salvo.

jp: 「助かるけども！？」
脱出、その後
小さなイカダに乗った漂流者を発見した。「無人島から自力で脱出してきたけれど、もう限界…」
jp_grezzo: "小さなイカダに乗った漂流者を発見した。「無人島から自力で脱出してきたけれど、もう限界…」"
en: You found a drifter on a small raft that escaped from an uninhabited island.
en_grezzo: "You found a drifter on a small raft that escaped from an uninhabited island."
it: Hai trovato un naufrago su una zattera, fuggito da un'isola deserta.

jp: 旅糧を１つ投げて去る
「ひ、ひどい」
「おーい！？」
「乗せてぇえ…！」
「これで頑張れと！？」
en: Are you telling me to do my best with this!?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("Are you telling me to do my best with this!?")

jp: 漂流者たち
漂流者複数名を発見した。「船が沈んでこのザマです…」
jp_grezzo: "漂流者複数名を発見した。「船が沈んでこのザマです…」"
en: You found drifters thrown out of the wrecked ship.
en_grezzo: "You found drifters thrown out of the wrecked ship."
it: Hai trovato dei naufraghi sbalzati fuori dal relitto della loro nave.

jp: まとめて見捨てる
乗せられるだけ乗せる
en: (Put on your ship as much as you can)
en_grezzo: "(Put on your ship as much as you can)"
it: (Farne salire a bordo il più possibile)

jp: 浮き輪を１つ投げて去る
「鬼だ…」
「ウソだろ！？」
「子供だけでも乗せてやってくれー！」
jp_grezzo: "「子供だけでも乗せてやってくれー！」"
en: At least you can do is save the kids!!?
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("At least you can do is save the kids!!?")
it: Almeno i bambini, portali via tu!!

jp: 「ありがとう！ありがとう！」
「これ以上は乗れないか…残念だ」
jp_grezzo: "「これ以上は乗れないか…残念だ」"
en: It looks like I can't get on this ship...
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("It looks like I can't get on this ship...")
it: Non c'è più posto per me... peccato.

jp: 無事に陸まで連れて行ってあげよう。
jp_grezzo: "無事に陸まで連れて行ってあげよう。"
en: You should get drifters to shore safely.
en_grezzo: "You should get drifters to shore safely."
it: Bisogna portarli a riva sani e salvi.

jp: 「どけ！俺のだ！」「子供もいるのよ！？」
jp_grezzo: "「どけ！俺のだ！」「子供もいるのよ！？」"
en: \"That life buoy is mine!!\" \"What about the kids!?\"
en_grezzo: "\"That life buoy is mine!!\" \"What about the kids!?\""

jp: 上空の脅威
急に空が薄暗くなり、船が何度も衝撃を受ける…。外を見たあなたの視界に飛び込んできたのは…海鳥だ。巨大な海鳥達が、群れをなして船を襲ってきたのだ！
jp_grezzo: "急に空が薄暗くなり、船が何度も衝撃を受ける…。外を見たあなたの視界に飛び込んできたのは…海鳥だ。巨大な海鳥達が、群れをなして船を襲ってきたのだ！"
en: The sky suddenly darkens, and your ship receives repeated shocks... When you look outside, what jumps into your sight is...seabirds. A flock of giant seabirds is attacking your ship!
en_grezzo: "The sky suddenly darkens, and your ship receives repeated shocks... When you look outside, what jumps into your sight is...seabirds. A flock of giant seabirds is attacking your ship!"
it: Il cielo si fa buio all'improvviso e la nave incassa un urto dopo l'altro... Ti affacci a guardare, e quel che ti si para davanti sono... uccelli marini. Uno stormo di uccelli marini giganteschi si sta avventando sulla nave!

jp: うむっ、緊急離脱だ
やさしく迎えてくれ
大きな損傷を受ける前に逃げ切ることができた。
jp_grezzo: "大きな損傷を受ける前に逃げ切ることができた。"
en: Your ship was able to escape before it was severely damaged.
en_grezzo: "Your ship was able to escape before it was severely damaged."
it: La nave è riuscita a fuggire prima di subire danni gravi.

jp: どうにか逃げきれたが、船がそれなりに損傷を受けた。
jp_grezzo: "どうにか逃げきれたが、船がそれなりに損傷を受けた。"
en: Your ship managed to escape, but suffered some damage...
en_grezzo: "Your ship managed to escape, but suffered some damage..."
it: La nave è riuscita a fuggire, ma ha rimediato la sua dose di danni...

jp: 大きな損傷を受ける前に大砲で追い払うことができた。
jp_grezzo: "大きな損傷を受ける前に大砲で追い払うことができた。"
en: Your ship was able to drive off the seabirds with its cannon before it was severely damaged.
en_grezzo: "Your ship was able to drive off the seabirds with its cannon before it was severely damaged."
it: La nave è riuscita a respingere gli uccelli marini a cannonate prima di subire danni gravi.

jp: どうにか追い払えたが、船がそれなりに損傷を受けた。
jp_grezzo: "どうにか追い払えたが、船がそれなりに損傷を受けた。"
en: Your ship managed to drive off the seabirds, but suffered some damage...
en_grezzo: "Your ship managed to drive off the seabirds, but suffered some damage..."
it: La nave è riuscita a respingere gli uccelli marini, ma ha rimediato la sua dose di danni...

jp: 度重なる損傷により、あなたの船は大破した。
jp_grezzo: "度重なる損傷により、あなたの船は大破した。"
en: Your ship is wrecked due to repeated damage...
en_grezzo: "Your ship is wrecked due to repeated damage..."
it: A furia di incassare colpi, la tua nave è andata distrutta...

jp: 海中の脅威
突如、海中から突き上げられるように船が大きく揺れた…。何事かと海中に目を凝らしたあなたは、サメが船底に体当たりしているのを目撃した！
jp_grezzo: "突如、海中から突き上げられるように船が大きく揺れた…。何事かと海中に目を凝らしたあなたは、サメが船底に体当たりしているのを目撃した！"
en: Suddenly, your ship shook violently as if it was pushed up from the sea... As you peek into the sea, you see a shark ramming the bottom of the ship!
en_grezzo: "Suddenly, your ship shook violently as if it was pushed up from the sea... As you peek into the sea, you see a shark ramming the bottom of the ship!"
it: All'improvviso la nave sobbalza, come sollevata di peso dal mare... Scruti l'acqua per capire, e vedi uno squalo che sperona la chiglia!

jp: シャクだが逃げよう
フカヒレにしてやりたい
大きな損傷を受ける前に魚雷でサメを爆殺した。
jp_grezzo: "大きな損傷を受ける前に魚雷でサメを爆殺した。"
en: Your ship was able to kill the shark with torpedoes before it was severely damaged.
en_grezzo: "Your ship was able to kill the shark with torpedoes before it was severely damaged."
it: La nave è riuscita a far saltare in aria lo squalo con un siluro prima di subire danni gravi.

jp: どうにかサメを仕留めたが、船がそれなりに損傷を受けた。
jp_grezzo: "どうにかサメを仕留めたが、船がそれなりに損傷を受けた。"
en: Your ship managed to kill the shark, but suffered some damage...
en_grezzo: "Your ship managed to kill the shark, but suffered some damage..."
it: La nave è riuscita ad ammazzare lo squalo, ma ha rimediato la sua dose di danni...
